BrochureContent.Content:
Located in the heart of the ever-popular coastal village of Kinvara, The Stables presents a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious detached family home with the added benefit of a substantial detached annex. The main residence offers bright and well-proportioned accommodation comprising a welcoming entrance hallway, an expansive sitting and dining rooms perfect for family gatherings and entertaining, a well-appointed kitchen, utility room, four generous bedrooms, two of which benefit from ensuite bathrooms, and a practical layout designed for comfortable everyday living. Externally, the property enjoys off-street parking, well-maintained lawn gardens to both the front and rear, together with two private patio areas, providing the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and relaxation.

A standout feature of this exceptional property is the detached annex, offering its own open-plan living, kitchen and dining area, three spacious double bedrooms and a bathroom. Whether used for multi-generational living, guest accommodation or as a flexible space for extended family, the annex provides endless possibilities. 

Ideally positioned within easy walking distance of Kinvara's renowned cafés, restaurants, shops, schools, picturesque quay and all local amenities, the property also enjoys an excellent location just a 30-minute drive from Galway City, with easy access to the spectacular Burren National Park and the world-famous Wild Atlantic Way. Combining the convenience of village living with exceptional flexibility and connectivity, this is a truly outstanding opportunity to acquire a unique family home in one of South Galway's most sought-after coastal locations.
